records.description_rewritten: The English directory label 'Quiet park' refers to Leise-Park, a small protected park created on part of a former cemetery in Prenzlauer Berg, not a generic unnamed green space. Berlin district sources say the park gates are locked in the evening, dogs and barbecues prohibited, and part of the former grave setting remains. Planet Randy's sole 28 July 2021 comment is vague and does not describe definite cruising. Its editorial assertion of frequent weekend sex parties is unsupported and conflicts with the managed park's opening model.

Berlin district states gate is locked evenings and dogs/barbecues forbidden.
City confirms former cemetery and public playground nature.

The sole Planet Randy cruising article describes anonymous encounters near wooded shores, without a single posted user review or dated visitor report. Berlin's official water profile instead documents a 5-km freely accessible shore with fenced nature-protection sections; recent 2026 water tests assessed swimming suitability. This establishes the leisure location, not gay cruising.

City lake/shore and Natura 2000 profile with fenced areas.
2026 lake bathing quality, no cruising evidence.
